#### Syllabus and Class Notes

| Unit              | Syllabus                         |       Vibha's Notes                |
| :---------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Unit 1            |  - Algorithms <br> - Fundamentals of Algorithmic Problem Solving <br> - Analysis of Algorithm Efficiency <br> - Analysis Framework <br> - Asymptotic Notations and Basic Efficiency Classes <br> - Mathematical Analysis of Non-Recursive and Recursive Algorithms <br> - Algebraic structures - Rings, Fields and Groups | [DAA Unit 1.pdf](DAA%20Unit%201.pdf) |
| Unit 2            | **Brute Force**: <br> - Selection Sort, Bubble Sort, Sequential Search <br> - Brute Force String Matching <br> - Exhaustive Search <br> **Divide-and-Conquer**: <br> - Master Theorem <br> - Merge Sort, Quick Sort <br> - Binary Search <br> - Binary Tree Traversals <br> - Multiplication of Large Integers <br> - Strassen’s Matrix Multiplication | [DAA Unit 2.pdf](DAA%20Unit%202.pdf) |
| Unit 3            | **Decrease-and-Conquer**: <br> - Insertion sort, topological sort <br> - Algorithms for generating combinatorial objects <br> - Decrease by a constant factor algorithms <br> **Transform-and-Conquer**: <br> - Pre-sorting, heap sort <br> - Red-Black trees, 2-3 trees, B-trees  | [DAA Unit 3.pdf](DAA%20Unit%203.pdf) |
| Unit 4            | **Space and Time Tradeoffs**: <br> - Sorting by Counting <br> - Input Enhancement in String Matching <br> - Horspool’s and Boyer-Moore Algorithms. <br> **Greedy Technique**: <br> - Prim’s Algorithm, Kruskal’s Algorithm and union-find algorithm <br> - Dijkstra’s Algorithm, Huffman Trees | [DAA Unit 4.pdf](DAA%20Unit%204.pdf) |
| Unit 5            | **Limitations of Algorithm Power**: <br> - Lower-Bound Arguments, Decision Trees <br> - P, NP, and NP- Complete, NP-Hard Problems <br> **Coping with the Limitations of Algorithm Power**: <br> - Backtracking, Branch-and-Bound <br> **Dynamic Programming**: <br> - Computing a Binomial Coefficient <br> - The Knapsack Problem and Memory Functions <br> - Warshall’s and Floyd’s Algorithms | [DAA Unit 5.pdf](DAA%20Unit%205.pdf) |
